title: Concert venue
content: I have dreamed of a mall world occasionally my whole life. Somewhat recently I have made some big life change and for the last few weeks my dreams have been become very vivid again. Last night I visited the mall world and this time it was a venue of all venues. Rooms and rooms of different types of concert theaters and dance clubs. I did drive to the place but once i got there I had a bag that was full of wrist band/tickets and stickers. I decided to start leaving them out for people to find. I was putting them on tables out in the hallway between venues. They were so unreal though, holograms and psychedelic patterns and symbols. Most people didn't notice me and were just going from one place to another. Except for a handful of gothic/wizard/biker looking people with a sort of sinister vibe who just sat in the hallway. They smiled and nodded at me as if they knew what I was doing and approved. No one spoke to me and I was alone. It felt like a mission.
